payload.description_html: Otodontid shark Kenolamna gunsoni (Siverson, 1996) gen. nov., lower lateroposterior teeth, uppermost Gearle Siltstone, middle Cenomanian (Late Cretaceous), Zone CC10a; CY Creek, Giralia Range, Western Australia. A. WAM 09.6.29, right lp1? from a juvenile individual; lingual (A1), profile (A2), and labial (A3) views. B. WAM 09.6.32, left lp1?; labial (B1), profile (B2), and lingual (B3) views. C. WAM 09.6.31, left lp1?; lingual (C1), basal (C2), labial (C3), and profile (C4) views. D. WAM 09.6.35, left lp2?; lingual (D1), profile (D2), and labial (D3) views. E. WAM 09.6.38, left lp5?; labial (E1, stereopair), lingual (E2), and profile (E3) views. F. WAM 11.12.4, left lp9?; profile (F1), basal (F2), labial (F3), and lingual (F4) views
